#@path: src/core/settings/settings_core.gd
class_name SettingsCore
extends RefCounted

## ConfigFile, FileAccess and OS.get_name() are named in a comment: it passes.
var _get_seam: Callable
var _timer_note: String = "Time.get_ticks_usec()"
var timer: Timer
var override_time: float = 0.0


func get_value(section: String, key: String) -> Variant:
	return _get_seam.call(section, key, null)
